conditional_findings.classification: Previously recorded 059 historical finding, independently reconnected to the 95e source; not a new historical finding or additional proven unique issue.
conditional_findings.severity: unassigned; conditional required-asset load failure with source-derived status consequence
conditional_findings.trace: The normal art-demo run installs TacticalPresentationPlugin, which installs TacticalMaterialsPlugin, which installs BakedTexturesPlugin. The plugin initializes ProceduralTextureResidency and its Update installer; lazy startup reserves stable destinations and scenery show requests its named recipes. The residency stores each requested strong recipe handle, but is_ready checks only membership in installed, and the installer adds a recipe to installed only after its RuntimeTextureRecipe is available and its maps are inserted. The loader can return I/O, decode or filename mismatch errors. Pinned Bevy source records an asset-load failure and exposes Failed separately; the residency API does not surface that state to scenery_ready.
conditional_findings.conditional_case: If an actual requested required scenery texture has failed and does not later successfully reload or install, and the app continues normally without a higher-priority independent terminal error, is_ready remains false. scenery_ready returns Ok(false), show retains PendingScenery with an Ok(None) procedural scene, and subsequent spawn_pending passes return while the pending marker remains. report_readiness therefore reports Loading for the selected exhibit; the browser status consumer displays Loading exhibit rather than the unavailable cause. This is a source-level conditional argument, not a performed failed-asset fixture, browser observation, renderer result or proof that any shipped texture is broken. The user may navigate away, and external retry/reload policy is separately unresolved.
conditional_findings.first_failed_contract: Required per-recipe readiness must distinguish terminal failure with its identity and cause from a request still in progress.
conditional_findings.canonical_owner: Per-recipe ProceduralTextureResidency outcome at the native asset-loading and installation boundary, consumed by art-demo scenery readiness and user-facing status.
conditional_findings.connected_repair: Design a checked pending/installed/failed outcome that retains the requested recipe identity and original cause, propagate it through scenery readiness to unavailable status, and explicitly define retry/cancellation. Preserve stable destination handles, successful loading, intentional empty recipe lists and other consumers; do not infer a shared implementation with unrelated capture readiness.
conditional_findings.later_acceptance: Only after separate implementation and product-validation authorization, exercise pending, successful, failed and retried required textures for both scenery exhibits and a studio exhibit, preserving status and any independently failed oak impostor cause.
conditional_findings.discovery: partial; actual runtime/native outcomes, retry policy, other is_ready consumers and global exact aliases remain open

existing_contract_connections.trace: The oak path checks its root impostor handle for LoadState::Failed before is_loaded_with_dependencies. The inspected PreparedTreeImpostorLoader ignores its LoadContext and constructs its asset from embedded decoded bytes, with no visible external dependency registration in that loader. The native is_loaded_with_dependencies predicate requires loaded root and loaded recursive states. The earlier hypothetical recursive dependency failure is therefore not treated as a proved reachable second defect for this particular loader; texture failure may prevent reaching the oak check at all.
existing_contract_connections.remaining: Asset framework dependency registration, all actual loaders, retries, cancellation and failure precedence remain open. No corrupted or missing impostor was loaded.

existing_contract_connections.trace: PendingCityBuildings retains the first formatted failure while finished means the queue is empty; completed counts removed failures as processed. report_readiness prioritizes Loading while that queue is not finished and reports its failure once finished. Its generic advance helper requeues Ok(false), and a source test illustrates failure plus pending; the inspected production CityBuildingAssets::spawn returns Ok(true) on success or an error and has no Ok(false) branch. This narrows a claim of a permanent pending wait from that test alone. The separately recorded structured cause/placement ownership issue remains distinct.
existing_contract_connections.remaining: Other actual scheduling, construction failures, progress and presentation policy remain open; no streaming system, test or city fixture was run.

existing_contract_connections.trace: district::curate mutates its supplied input before validation and furniture decode can fail, but the only production caller located in the exact 95e repository constructs a local candidate in prepare_input and returns on error before passing it to scenery spawn. That specific caller does not establish a partially committed shared world from curate failure. scenery::spawn has its own earlier world mutations before later fallible work, which are a separate open question.
existing_contract_connections.remaining: Other semantic furniture/anchor validation, fixture data, scenery partial publication and all callers remain open. No generated world or test was run.

existing_contract_connections.trace: The source embeds a fixed ten-entry catalog; static data inspection found each enum ID once, finite 3-coordinate focus values and positive finite distances. Six weapon asset names occur in the embedded gameplay catalogue, and the private weapon helper asks default_design for that name. This bounds claims based on an arbitrary malformed external catalog or missing listed identifier, but does not prove geometry generation, aggregate validation, native camera behavior or every consumer. Earlier segovb separately registered and read this catalogue as a mandatory extension, outside the original role population; exact original and current bytes agree.
existing_contract_connections.remaining: Owner fit, cross-field admission, alternative producers, generated bounds and native arithmetic remain open. Catalog parsing here is evidence-only and does not execute the product.

existing_contract_connections.trace: The wasm entry exports command and status; the browser selects an exhibit, sends typed show JSON, polls status, shows a terminal error for unavailable/failed and hides loading only when ready. The command boundary rejects nonfinite orbit, zoom and pan values; browser and runtime are source-inspected only.
existing_contract_connections.remaining: Boot lifecycle, native status scheduling, concurrent navigation, actual web execution and all consumers remain open.
